metadata.notes:
Released January 18, 2020.

Included with orders from the Studio71 Isaac store for a time in January, 2020.

Later included with orders from the Nicalis Isaac store for a time starting February 11th, 2020 and with orders of Tapeworm through the Nicalis store for a time starting January 16, 2021.

Foil-only.

metadata.notes: This "Alt Art" of the Level One Isaac card from the Anniversary set (identical in every way but set symbol) was printed and accidentally leaked from a small game store before the card's set was finalized.  After the Anniversary set included the final version of the card, Maestro Media began sending out some copies of this "Alt Art" version as a rare promo to dedicated fans.
